question: Cloudburst Over Kheer Ganga River Triggers Flash Floods in Uttarkashi. Which village was affected by the flash floods?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Dharali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Cloudburst Over Kheer Ganga River Triggers Flash Floods in Uttarkashi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **cloudburst** occurred over the **Kheer Ganga River**, a **tributary of the Alaknanda River**.

 
 
• 
 
It triggered **flash floods** in **Dharali**, a **high-altitude village** in **Uttarkashi district**, **Uttarakhand**.

 
 
• 
 
A **cloudburst** is defined as **extremely intense rainfall** exceeding **100 mm in one hour** over a small area (~10 km²).

 
 
• 
 
These events are common in **mountainous regions**, especially the **Himalayas**.

 
 
• 
 
Causes include **steep terrain**, **orographic lift**, and **localized convection**.
